description: Lightweight personal subscription tracker with statistics and optional notifications.

promotion.reason: Qualified on 2026-09-10 and approved by the owner. A real install proved it starts, opens to a usable screen, survives a restart and a keep-data reinstall with its data intact, and removes everything it created. 5.5.0 was rebuilt 2026-09-01; upstream released 5.6.0 on 2026-09-08, so this is one minor version behind a two-day-old release. One container keeping a SQLite file in its managed folder.

risk_notes: Creates 1 Docker container and publishes one port on this computer's loopback interface only.
Keeps its data in this app's managed folder. A keep-data uninstall leaves it; deleting data removes it permanently.
Proven on Windows with Docker's Linux engine. macOS and Linux hosts are unverified.
Keeps a record of what you pay for and when. The first person to open it creates the account, and it can fetch exchange rates and send reminders only if you give it the keys and addresses to do so.
